about: Revealed preferences as Beli-style Boolean answers. Each entry is one answer worth 1 comparison against a prior of alpha=4. Only actions with a public record are used.

zwicker.why: S1677 keeps a 3-sensor mandate and a human-driver phase even though it shuts out Tesla and delays Waymo.
Zwicker: the bill is 'pro New Jersey safety', not anti-Tesla.

mayor_solomon.why: Cut Via evenings and Saturdays and raised the fare to $2.55 to close a ~$90M gap.

ny_hochul.why: Pulled her own robotaxi plan after driver and transit unions opposed it on job grounds.

nyc_mamdani.why: Let Waymo's permits lapse; DOT: AV decisions 'will center workers and their well-being'.

uber.why: Uber's NJ lobbyists circulated a bill keeping 85% of rideshare work with human drivers on robotaxi platforms for 3 years.
